subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Consider the following statements regarding a 
signal x(t) = e–|t| 
 
1. 
x(t) is an energy signal 
 
2. 
x(t) is an odd signal 
 
3. 
x(t) is an even signal 
 
4. 
x(t) is neither even nor odd. 
 
Which of the above statement is/are true? 
 
(a) only 4 
(b) 1 and 3 
 
(c) 1 and 4 
(d) 1 and 2
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-08 (Periodic/Aperiodic, Even/odd,).
